route.instructions: Select the single group of tools that can serve this utterance; if it is plain conversation needing no tool, choose chitchat

criteria.home: Lights on, off, a colour, or brightness; or the thermostat temperature
criteria.clock: The current time, one timer, or one alarm
criteria.reminders: Add, list, or complete a reminder
criteria.media: Play music by genre, mood, artist, or title; or control the current playback
criteria.weather: Current weather or a short forecast
criteria.comms: Send a message or an email, or place a phone call
criteria.knowledge: Look something up on the web, open a URL, or search the user's documents
criteria.workspace: Multi-step work on files, code, a shell, or GitHub
criteria.chitchat: A greeting, thanks, or conversational reply that needs no tool
